content.short: Nakamoto Games is a Polygon-based game studio that builds Web3-based play-to-earn games.
content.description: Since its December 2020 launch by Chawalit Rugsasri, Nakamoto Games has built a play-to-earn ecosystem around hypercasual titles. Built on Polygon, the platform features in-house games such as Night Warriors and Spooky games alongside third-party releases, giving players access to a wide variety of options. Some games host tournaments with rewards. Independent developers can upload their games to Nakamoto and earn royalties whenever players engage with them.
